WOW Pune 2025

GDGoC Pune's flagship WOW event, held on 19 April 2025 at MIT WPU. As design lead, I shaped everything attendees saw, from the website they registered on to the badges they wore.

RoleDesign lead
TeamGDGoC Pune, with a peer on the website
TimelineFeb – Apr 2025
ScopeWebsite, collateral, live event visuals
01 — The brief

Make a student event feel like Google

Every piece had to sit comfortably inside Google's brand and Material Design, while still feeling like our event, and like Pune. One system had to stretch across a website, printed collateral, merchandise and the live stage, for an audience of 1000+ developers.

02 — The theme

Doodles

The visual language is built from code symbols turned into doodles: brackets, hashes, slashes, quotes and arrows, drawn as chunky shapes in Google's four colours. Then I gave it a Pune accent: Ganpati Bappa, Shaniwar Wada and the city's own line, पुणे तेथे काय उणे.

Google blueGoogle redGoogle yellowGoogle greendoodle pink
03 — The website

The front door for 1000+ attendees

WOW Pune 2025 · GDGoC Pune
scroll inside the window to see the whole site ↓
Designed with a peer, following Material Design

One long page that does the whole job

Every section answers one question an attendee or speaker would have, in the order they'd have it.

  • Landing with a live countdown and one clear "Register now".
  • About as puzzle pieces: 10000+ participants, 25+ sessions, 35+ speakers, 2 days.
  • Speakers and a call for speakers to fill the line-up.
  • Sponsors, past events and FAQs, so nobody had to ask twice.
04 — Beyond the screen

One system, everywhere

The same doodles, colours and WOW wordmark carried from the website onto everything people held, wore and walked past.

05 — On the day

Backstage and live

Beyond the designs, I was backstage on the day handling live visuals and tech, keeping every screen on brand in real time.

1000+attendees on the day
5+platforms in one visual system
20+design assets delivered
24 hrsto design the event website, last minute
06 — What I took away

What this project says about me

01

I can design inside a big brand system without losing our own voice.

02

I keep one visual idea consistent across screens, print and a live stage.

03

I stay calm and useful when things happen live, and when deadlines are 24 hours away.
